metadata.cypher_query:
MATCH (e:Employee)
WHERE e.hourly_rate IS NOT NULL AND e.department IS NOT NULL
WITH e.department AS department, avg(e.hourly_rate) AS avg_hourly_rate
ORDER BY avg_hourly_rate DESC
WITH collect({department: department, avg_hourly_rate: avg_hourly_rate}) AS department_averages,
     max(avg_hourly_rate) AS highest_avg_hourly_rate
RETURN department_averages, highest_avg_hourly_rate, [x IN department_averages WHERE x.avg_hourly_rate = highest_avg_hourly_rate | x.department] AS highest_departments

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:HAS_POSITION]->(pos:Position)
WITH e.name AS employee,
     max(e.years_experience) AS years_experience,
     pos.name AS position,
     max(pos.min_years) AS min_years,
     max(pos.max_years) AS max_years
WITH employee, years_experience, position, min_years, max_years,
     CASE
       WHEN years_experience IS NULL OR min_years IS NULL OR max_years IS NULL THEN '기준정보없음'
       WHEN years_experience < min_years THEN '기준미달'
       WHEN years_experience > max_years THEN '기준초과'
       ELSE '기준일치'
     END AS alignment_status
RETURN position,
       min_years,
       max_years,
       alignment_status,
       COUNT(DISTINCT employee) AS employee_count,
       round(avg(years_experience) * 10) / 10.0 AS avg_years_experience
ORDER BY position, alignment_status

MATCH (e:Employee)
WHERE e.hire_date IS NOT NULL
WITH substring(e.hire_date, 0, 4) AS hire_year, COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS new_hires
RETURN hire_year, new_hires
ORDER BY hire_year ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WITH e.name AS employee, max(e.max_projects) AS max_projects, COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) AS assigned_projects
WHERE assigned_projects > max_projects
RETURN employee, max_projects, assigned_projects
ORDER BY assigned_projects DESC, employee

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WITH s.name AS skill, COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS employee_count
RETURN skill, employee_count
ORDER BY employee_count DESC, skill ASC
LIMIT 10

MATCH (s:Skill)
WHERE s.market_demand = $marketDemand
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:Employee)-[:HAS_SKILL]->(s)
WITH s.name AS skill, COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS employee_count
RETURN skill, employee_count
ORDER BY employee_count ASC, skill ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[r:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WHERE toLower(s.name) IN [toLower($skill1), toLower($skill2)]
  AND r.proficiency = $proficiency
WITH e.department AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS employee_count
RETURN department, employee_count
ORDER BY employee_count DESC, department ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[hs:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WITH e.name AS employee, max(e.job_type) AS job_type,
     COUNT(DISTINCT s.name) AS skill_count,
     AVG(hs.effective_rate) AS avg_effective_rate_per_employee
WITH job_type,
     AVG(skill_count) AS avg_skill_count,
     AVG(avg_effective_rate_per_employee) AS avg_effective_rate
RETURN job_type, avg_skill_count, avg_effective_rate
ORDER BY job_type

MATCH (p:Project)
WITH p.status AS status,
     sum(coalesce(p.budget_spent, 0)) AS total_budget_spent,
     sum(coalesce(p.budget_allocated, 0)) AS total_budget_allocated
RETURN status,
       total_budget_spent,
       total_budget_allocated,
       CASE
         WHEN total_budget_allocated = 0 THEN null
         ELSE toFloat(total_budget_spent) / total_budget_allocated
       END AS execution_rate
ORDER BY status

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WITH p.name AS project,
     max(p.required_headcount) AS required_headcount,
     COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS actual_assigned
WHERE actual_assigned < required_headcount
RETURN project, required_headcount, actual_assigned, (required_headcount - actual_assigned) AS shortage
ORDER BY shortage DESC, project ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WITH p.name AS project,
     COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS employee_count,
     AVG(w.contribution_percent) AS avg_contribution_percent
RETURN project, employee_count, avg_contribution_percent
ORDER BY employee_count DESC, avg_contribution_percent DESC
LIMIT 5

MATCH (p:Project)
WITH p.type AS project_type,
     avg(p.budget_million) AS avg_budget_million,
     avg(p.duration_months) AS avg_duration_months
RETURN project_type, avg_budget_million, avg_duration_months
ORDER BY project_type

MATCH (e:Employee)-[hs:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)<-[req:REQUIRES]-(p:Project)
WHERE req.required_proficiency IN ['고급']
  AND hs.proficiency IN ['고급', '전문가']
WITH e.department AS department, e.name AS employee, COLLECT(DISTINCT s.name) AS matchedSkills
WHERE size(matchedSkills) > 0
RETURN department, COUNT(DISTINCT employee) AS employeeCount
ORDER BY employeeCount DESC, department ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WHERE p.status = $projectStatus AND w.role = $role
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:HAS_POSITION]->(pos:Position)
WITH e.name AS employee, coalesce(max(pos.name), $unknownPosition) AS position
RETURN position, COUNT(DISTINCT employee) AS employee_count
ORDER BY employee_count DESC, position ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:HAS_CERTIFICATE]->(c:Certificate)
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WHERE p.status = '진행중'
WITH e.name AS employee,
     COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS certificate_count,
     COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) AS active_project_count
RETURN employee, certificate_count, active_project_count
ORDER BY certificate_count DESC, active_project_count DESC, employee ASC
LIMIT 10

MATCH (mentor:Employee)-[:MENTORS]->(mentee:Employee)
WITH mentor.name AS mentor_name,
     COUNT(DISTINCT mentee.name) AS mentee_count,
     max(mentor.department) AS department
OPTIONAL MATCH (m:Employee)-[:HAS_POSITION]->(pos:Position)
WHERE m.name = mentor_name
WITH mentor_name, mentee_count, department, collect(DISTINCT pos.name) AS positions
UNWIND positions AS position
WITH mentor_name, mentee_count, department, position
RETURN round(avg(1.0 * mentee_count), 2) AS avg_mentees_per_mentor,
       position AS position_name,
       department AS department_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT mentor_name) AS mentor_count,
       round(avg(1.0 * mentee_count), 2) AS avg_mentees_in_group
ORDER BY mentor_count DESC, avg_mentees_in_group DESC, position_name, department_name

MATCH (e:Employee)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WHERE w.agreed_rate < e.hourly_rate
WITH COUNT(w) AS lower_priced_assignments
RETURN lower_priced_assignments

MATCH (e:Employee)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WITH e.name AS employee, p.name AS project,
     sum(coalesce(w.actual_hours, 0)) AS actual_hours,
     sum(coalesce(w.allocated_hours, 0)) AS allocated_hours
WITH employee, project, actual_hours, allocated_hours,
     (actual_hours - allocated_hours) AS gap,
     abs(actual_hours - allocated_hours) AS abs_gap
RETURN employee, project, actual_hours, allocated_hours, gap, abs_gap
ORDER BY abs_gap DESC, employee ASC, project ASC

MATCH (d:Department)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(e:Employee)-[:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
WITH d.name AS department,
     max(d.budget_billion) AS department_budget_billion,
     sum(DISTINCT p.budget_million) AS total_project_budget_million
RETURN department,
       department_budget_billion,
       total_project_budget_million,
       CASE
         WHEN department_budget_billion IS NULL OR department_budget_billion = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE round((toFloat(total_project_budget_million) / (department_budget_billion * 1000.0)) * 10000) / 100.0
       END AS project_budget_ratio_percent
ORDER BY project_budget_ratio_percent DESC, department ASC

MATCH (d:Department)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(o:Office)
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:Employee)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(d)
WITH o.name AS office,
     COUNT(DISTINCT d.name) AS department_count,
     COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS total_employees,
     SUM(DISTINCT d.budget_billion) AS total_department_budget_billion
RETURN office, department_count, total_employees, total_department_budget_billion
ORDER BY office

MATCH (p:Project)
WHERE p.type = $projectType
  AND p.status = $projectStatus
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:Employee)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p)
WITH p.name AS project, max(p.required_headcount) AS required_headcount,
     COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) AS current_staff,
     (COUNT(DISTINCT e.name) - max(p.required_headcount)) AS staffing_gap
RETURN project, required_headcount, current_staff, staffing_gap
ORDER BY staffing_gap ASC, project ASC

MATCH (p:Project)-[req:REQUIRES]->(s:Skill)
WHERE toLower(p.name) = toLower($projectName)
OPTIONAL MATCH (e:Employee)-[w:WORKS_ON]->(p)
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[hs:HAS_SKILL]->(s)
WITH p.name AS project,
     s.name AS skill,
     req.required_proficiency AS required_proficiency,
     collect(DISTINCT e.name) AS assigned_employees,
     collect(DISTINCT CASE
       WHEN e.name IS NOT NULL AND hs.proficiency = req.required_proficiency THEN e.name
       ELSE NULL
     END) AS exact_match_employees,
     collect(DISTINCT CASE
       WHEN e.name IS NOT NULL AND (
         (req.required_proficiency = '초급' AND hs.proficiency IN ['초급','중급','고급','전문가']) OR
         (req.required_proficiency = '중급' AND hs.proficiency IN ['중급','고급','전문가']) OR
         (req.required_proficiency = '고급' AND hs.proficiency IN ['고급','전문가'])
       ) THEN e.name
       ELSE NULL
     END) AS covered_employees
RETURN project,
       skill,
       required_proficiency,
       [name IN assigned_employees WHERE name IS NOT NULL] AS assigned_employees,
       size([name IN assigned_employees WHERE name IS NOT NULL]) AS assigned_count,
       [name IN exact_match_employees WHERE name IS NOT NULL] AS exact_match_employees,
       size([name IN exact_match_employees WHERE name IS NOT NULL]) AS exact_match_count,
       [name IN covered_employees WHERE name IS NOT NULL] AS covered_employees,
       size([name IN covered_employees WHERE name IS NOT NULL]) AS covered_count,
       CASE WHEN size([name IN covered_employees WHERE name IS NOT NULL]) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS is_covered
ORDER BY skill

MATCH (e:Employee)-[hs:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WHERE ANY(skillName IN $skillNames WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower(skillName))
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (e)-[:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)
    WHERE toLower(p.name) = toLower($projectName)
  }
RETURN e, hs, s
LIMIT 200

MATCH (p:Project)-[req:REQUIRES]->(s:Skill)
WHERE toLower(p.name) = toLower($projectName)
  AND req.importance = '필수'
WITH p.name AS projectName,
     collect(DISTINCT s.name) AS requiredSkills,
     max(req.max_hourly_rate) AS projectMaxHourlyRate
MATCH (e:Employee)-[hs:HAS_SKILL]->(es:Skill)
WITH projectName, requiredSkills, projectMaxHourlyRate,
     e.name AS employee,
     max(e.hourly_rate) AS hourly_rate,
     collect(DISTINCT es.name) AS employeeSkills
WITH projectName, employee, hourly_rate, requiredSkills, projectMaxHourlyRate,
     [skill IN requiredSkills WHERE ANY(empSkill IN employeeSkills WHERE toLower(empSkill) = toLower(skill))] AS matchedRequiredSkills
WHERE size(matchedRequiredSkills) > 0
  AND (projectMaxHourlyRate IS NULL OR hourly_rate <= projectMaxHourlyRate)
RETURN projectName, employee, hourly_rate, matchedRequiredSkills, size(matchedRequiredSkills) AS matched_skill_count, size(requiredSkills) AS total_required_skill_count
ORDER BY matched_skill_count DESC, hourly_rate ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[r:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WHERE e.department = $department
  AND NOT ANY(item IN $excludedSkills WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower(item))
RETURN e, r, s
LIMIT 200

MATCH (e:Employee)-[:HAS_CERTIFICATE]->(c:Certificate)
WHERE NOT toLower(c.name) = toLower($excludedCertificate)
WITH e.name AS employee, collect(DISTINCT c.name) AS certificates
RETURN employee, certificates
ORDER BY employee

MATCH p = (e1:Employee)-[:WORKS_ON|MENTORS|BELONGS_TO|HAS_SKILL|HAS_CERTIFICATE|HAS_POSITION|LOCATED_AT*1..2]-(e2:Employee)
WHERE toLower(e1.name) = toLower($employee1)
  AND toLower(e2.name) = toLower($employee2)
RETURN p
LIMIT 200

MATCH (d1:Department)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(e1:Employee)
WHERE toLower(d1.name) = toLower($dept1)
MATCH (e1)-[r1:WORKS_ON]->(p:Project)<-[r2:WORKS_ON]-(bridge:Employee)
MATCH (bridge)-[r3:BELONGS_TO]->(d2:Department)
WHERE toLower(d2.name) = toLower($dept2) AND e1 <> bridge
RETURN e1, r1, p, r2, bridge, r3, d2
LIMIT 200

MATCH (s:Skill)
WHERE ANY(skillName IN $skillNames WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower(skillName))
MATCH (e:Employee)-[hs:HAS_SKILL]->(s)
OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(d:Department)
WITH e.name AS employee,
     collect(DISTINCT s.name) AS matched_skill_names,
     collect(DISTINCT d.name) AS departments,
     max(hs.proficiency) AS proficiency,
     max(hs.years_used) AS years_used,
     max(e.years_experience) AS total_experience
RETURN employee,
       matched_skill_names,
       departments,
       proficiency,
       years_used,
       total_experience
ORDER BY years_used DESC, total_experience DESC, employee ASC

MATCH (e:Employee)-[r:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower($skillName)
RETURN e, r, s
LIMIT 200

MATCH (e:Employee)-[r:HAS_SKILL]->(s:Skill)
WHERE ANY(skillName IN $skillNames WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower(skillName))
RETURN e, r, s
LIMIT 200

MATCH (e:Employee)-[r1:HAS_SKILL]->(s1:Skill)
WHERE ANY(name IN $backendSkills WHERE toLower(s1.name) = toLower(name) OR toLower(s1.category) = toLower(name))
WITH DISTINCT e
MATCH (e)-[r2:HAS_SKILL]->(s2:Skill)
WHERE ANY(name IN $aiMlSkills WHERE toLower(s2.name) = toLower(name) OR toLower(s2.category) = toLower(name))
RETURN e, r2, s2
LIMIT 200

MATCH (target:Project)
WHERE toLower(target.name) = toLower($projectName)
MATCH (core:Employee)-[w1:WORKS_ON]->(target)
WHERE w1.role = '개발자' OR w1.contribution_percent >= 30
MATCH (core)-[w2:WORKS_ON]->(past:Project)<-[w3:WORKS_ON]-(collab:Employee)
WHERE toLower(past.name) <> toLower($projectName)
  AND collab <> core
  AND (past.status = '완료' OR (past.start_date IS NOT NULL AND target.start_date IS NOT NULL AND past.start_date < target.start_date))
RETURN core, w1, target, w2, past, w3, collab
LIMIT 200
